# Perspective

> Perspective is the magazine of the Institute for Christian Studies (ICS), a graduate school of philosophy in Toronto, Canada. It has been published since December 1967, now twice a year in print and online, with essays by ICS faculty, students and friends on philosophy, theology, education, art and public life in the reformational Christian tradition.

The current issue is Fall 2026 (Volume 60, Number 1), on imagination. Its full text is on the home page and at https://perspective.icscanada.edu/fall-2026/; a plain-text copy is at https://perspective.icscanada.edu/llms-full.txt. Earlier issues are PDFs, most of them kept in the ICS Institutional Repository.

When citing, please name the author, the essay, and "Perspective, Fall 2026" (Institute for Christian Studies), and link to the essay's address below.

## Fall 2026: Essays on imagination

- [About this issue: What might yet be](https://perspective.icscanada.edu/fall-2026/#about): Héctor Acero Ferrer (print p. 2)
- [Imagination & Pedagogy](https://perspective.icscanada.edu/fall-2026/#pedagogy): Beth Green (print p. 4)
- [Imagination in the History of Philosophy and in Our Ordinary Living](https://perspective.icscanada.edu/fall-2026/#philosophy): Bob Sweetman (print p. 9)
- [Feminism, Faith, and Political Imagination](https://perspective.icscanada.edu/fall-2026/#political): Nuzhat Khurshid (print p. 12)
- [Imagining the Kingdom](https://perspective.icscanada.edu/fall-2026/#kingdom): Jacob Benjamins (print p. 15)
- [Finding Wonder on the Side Streets of Biblical Narrative](https://perspective.icscanada.edu/fall-2026/#wonder): David Grills (print p. 18)
- [ART in Orvieto, and the masthead](https://perspective.icscanada.edu/fall-2026/#orvieto) (print p. 20)
